content:
STMicroelectronics has just introduced the VL53LB (VL53LBCA), its smallest Time-of-Flight (ToF) ranging sensor, part of the FlightSense portfolio, with a size of just 4.0 × 1.8 × 1.0 mm. Like the earlier VL53L0X and VL53L1X models, it’s a single-zone ToF sensor featuring a 940 nm invisible vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL), but it offers a longer range of up to 8 meters and supports multi-object detection. It’s 30% smaller than the previous generation (VL53L3) and consumes just 50 µW in ULP mode, which makes it ideal for smartphones and space-constrained robotics and industrial systems. ST VL53LB key features and specifications: Low-power microcontroller running digital firmware Emitter – 940 nm invisible vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL) and its analog driver Distance ranging Histogram-based technology, with the possibility to output distance and raw histograms from the chip Detection Range 5mm up to 8+ m with up to 1% accuracy Longer range in dark room [...]
